title: Grateful Dead Live at Recreation Hall, UC Davis on 1982-03-14
lineage: Transfer: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A (Dolby-B in) > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 07/2019
source: Source: FOB Beyers M88's > Sony TC-D5M > Maxell XLIIS. Concert recording by Rip Tompkins, & with thanks to Richie Stankiewicz!

ai_review.summary: A good raw audience tape that captures the high‑energy, classic vibe of a great touring Dead show.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a very good audience tape with solid work by the taping crew, delivering clear enough sound for listeners who prefer crowd ambience. While no specific songs are highlighted, the reviewer emphasizes the timeless, high‑energy feel of the performance, describing it as pure, old‑fashioned Dead magic.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one positive 4‑star review; it highlights a good audience recording and overall great performance but lacks detailed musical specifics, leading to a moderate combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes the crew did a great job; described as a very good raw audience tape with clear enough sound for an audience source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer simply notes the show felt like classic, high‑energy Dead touring days.
